entities.summary: Thai, a notable figure in the history of Cambodia, associated with Jayavarman VII and Angkorian Zenith (1220–1431). Preceded by Theravada Shift and Decline of Angkor and Jayavarman VII's Buddhist Empire. Their legacy influenced Portuguese and Spanish missionaries and traders arrive in Cambodia.
